question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **heading**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Heading** means to start physically moving toward someone or something.

 
 
• **Example -** *I'm **heading** toward the west entrance because I thought that's where you are!*
 
 
 
• *​*To **head** somewhere generally denotes to **start moving**, as **opposed to 'go'.**
 
• **'Head' is generally used** with a **direction**; and **'go' is generally used** with a **destination**.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'heading'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Dust storms do not just happen in the middle of the desert. They can happen in __any__ (1) dry area where loose dirt can __easily__ (2) be picked up. Don't be surprised __if__ (3) you suddenly saw a dust storm **__heading__ (4)** your way. Dust storms usually (5)________ without warning.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Directing** means controlling the operations of; managing or governing.
 
• **Deciding** means serving to resolve or settle something.
 
• **Lashing** means something used for binding, wrapping, or fastening; strike or beat with a whip or stick.
